projects.title: EutroBot
projects.intro: An autonomous phytoremediation robot for restoring polluted water bodies.
projects.text: EutroBot combines robotics, artificial intelligence, IoT, and microbiology to address contamination below the water’s surface. Across four generations of prototypes, the project explores plant-based remediation as part of a water restoration system. Its development has also led to Operation Jal Rakshak, a nationwide initiative.
projects.extra: The project was a national finalist at SJWP India 3.0, placed seventh nationally at WRO 2025, and received second prize in the Story Behind My Tech category at STEMXPLORE 2026. A research paper on EutroBot was accepted for poster presentation at ICWS 2026, IIT Jodhpur.

projects.title: VAANI 2.0
projects.intro: Exploring Parkinsonian speech patterns through voice analysis.
projects.text: VAANI 2.0 develops the original ESP32 prototype into a full-stack web application. The published framework extracts 40 MFCC means and 40 MFCC standard deviations using Librosa, then uses a Random Forest classifier to investigate potential Parkinsonian speech patterns. The application includes interactive biomarker visualization, analysis, and downloadable reports.
projects.extra: Awarded second place at LingHacks VII in June 2026, with a ₹5,000 prize. This is a research screening prototype; clinical validation has not been established in the supplied project materials.

projects.title: VAANI 1.0
projects.intro: Investigating neurological voice biomarkers on an embedded device.
projects.text: The original VAANI prototype combined robotics and embedded machine learning on an ESP32. Development used ALS and Parkinson’s voice data from Synapse VOC-ALS and KaggleHub to explore onboard analysis and affordable voice-based screening.
projects.extra: This edge-computing prototype informed VAANI 2.0. It is a research system, not a clinically validated diagnostic device.

projects.title: EcoCredit
projects.intro: Making recycling rewarding through an IoT-enabled credit system.
projects.text: EcoCredit rewards recycling with virtual credits, exploring how incentives can increase participation in sustainable waste management. The robotic recycling system connects a physical recycling action to a digital reward.
projects.extra: The project won first place at KIIT IDEATHON 2.0 in June 2025 among more than 300 participants.

publications.title: VAANI 2.0: An AI-Powered Vocal Biomarker Framework for Preliminary Parkinson’s Disease Risk Screening
publications.text: A proof-of-concept framework combining browser-based voice recording, Librosa acoustic feature extraction, and Random Forest classification. Forty MFCC means and forty MFCC standard deviations form an 80-dimensional feature representation. The study evaluates preliminary Parkinson’s disease risk screening from short voice recordings.
publications.results: In the reported evaluation of 73 recordings, with 15 reserved for testing, accuracy was 80.0%, precision 80.0%, sensitivity 66.7%, F1-score 72.7%, and ROC–AUC 88.9%. The small dataset and test cohort limit generalisation. The work is positioned as preliminary screening and decision support, rather than diagnosis.

publications.title: Eutrobot: An Autonomous Unmanned Surface Vehicle Integrating Real Time Environmental Sensing, AI Assisted Algal Detection, and Phytoremediation for Scalable Freshwater Purification
publications.text: An autonomous surface vehicle combining environmental sensing, GPS-guided navigation, AI-assisted algal detection, and adaptive phytoremediation. The study describes monitoring 17 water-quality parameters, an onboard web server, a Lemna minor biomass deployment algorithm, and a HuskyLens-based algal detection and harvesting system.
publications.results: Reported field trials at Atladara Lake and Kalali Lake in Vadodara examined navigation and contamination detection. The paper presents an integrated approach to monitoring and freshwater restoration.

publications.title: Can Voice Reveal Neurodegeneration? A Theory and Prototype of an Offline AI Based Screening Device
publications.text: A neuroscience and AI theory paper exploring voice-based ALS screening and an offline device prototype.
